title: AgentSwitchboard reversible system bootstrap lifecycle

inspect: must distinguish ASB-owned state from merely-present external state
must report whether Remove is currently safe from recorded ownership plus observed drift
apply: must ascertain prerequisites before owned machine mutation
must persist original before-state before the first reversible machine mutation
must persist per-resource write-ahead intent before a reversible resource mutation when a crash between mutation and ownership journaling would otherwise make ownership ambiguous
must recover an interrupted pending mutation only when the observed resource matches either its recorded baseline or exact planned ASB state; a third state is drift
must update durable state as each mutation becomes ASB-owned
must preserve an original pre-ASB baseline across idempotent Apply or upgrade
must refuse to silently re-baseline a previously ASB-owned resource that drifted after a completed Apply
must verify final state before marking lifecycle status installed
remove: must require durable ownership evidence before reversing a present resource
must validate every incomplete owned rollback resource for drift before destructive rollback mutation
must reverse only deltas explicitly recorded as ASB-owned
must restore preexisting resources from verified backups or property-level snapshots
must persist rollbackComplete for each resource immediately after that resource is verified at its pre-ASB state
must resume an interrupted removing lifecycle from durable per-resource rollback checkpoints rather than restarting completed rollback work
must preserve unrelated configuration, files, PATH entries, credentials, and user state
must fail closed when a current incomplete owned surface matches neither its recorded post-Apply state nor an already-verified rollback state
must verify rollback before marking lifecycle status removed
must be idempotent after a completed Remove

dedicatedFile.install: record existed-before, before hash, changed-by-ASB, planned after hash when mutating, after hash, and backup path when replacement occurs
dedicatedFile.remove: delete only a file created by ASB or restore a verified preexisting backup; current file hash must match recorded ASB post-state before first rollback mutation; checkpoint verified rollback before continuing

dedicatedDirectory.remove: remove the directory only when ASB created it and it is empty after owned files are removed

machinePathEntry.install: record whether the exact normalized entry preexisted, write-ahead mutation intent, and whether ASB added it
machinePathEntry.remove: remove only exact entries recorded as addedByAsb; never normalize away unrelated entries; checkpoint absence after rollback

sharedJsonConfig.install: record property presence/value before ASB mutation, write-ahead mutation intent, and which exact properties ASB changed
sharedJsonConfig.remove: three-way/property-level rollback only; preserve unrelated properties, fail closed if an ASB-owned property drifted after Apply, and checkpoint verified baseline restoration

sharedMachineRoot.install: every adapter owns an adapter-specific subdirectory; shared roots are never recursively deleted by an adapter
sharedMachineRoot.remove: adapter may remove its own empty subdirectory only; shared AgentSwitchboard roots remain

failureRules.partialApplyOrRemove: preserve durable intermediate and per-resource checkpoint state for recovery; never pretend absent/installed/removed

forbidden: blind recursive deletion outside an adapter-owned canonical root
deleting a resource solely because its path resembles an ASB-managed path
removing PATH entries that predated ASB ownership
restoring an entire shared config file over unrelated later edits
silently re-baselining an ASB-owned resource after outside drift
restarting already checkpointed rollback work after an interrupted Remove
deleting provider credentials, user settings, sessions, project state, or caches unless a separate explicit contract owns them
claiming uninstall success without rollback verification
using a user-local receipt as the sole authority for machine-wide deletion
proofCeiling: This contract defines reversible ownership, write-ahead recovery, drift, and rollback checkpoint semantics. Each adapter must still prove its own resource-specific Apply/Remove behavior and physical machine execution.
